_draft: DRAFT, not published and not read by any client. It sketches the entry this component needs in the DisplayXR component catalog (displayxr-runtime docs/specs/runtime/component-catalog.md, schema 1), the signed index `dxr-get` reads. Real entries are DERIVED by the runtime's scripts/gen_catalog.py from versions.json and the signed release assets; nothing is hand-written into the catalog. Keys starting with '_' are notes for reviewers and are not part of the schema. Every '<...>' is a placeholder the generator fills from a real release.
_what_is_missing_today: versions.json has no `leia_conversion` field and gen_catalog.py emits no such component, so `dxr-get install leia_conversion` finds nothing to fetch. The Leia SR plug-in installer already calls it (and falls back to a pointer); it starts working when this entry is published.

windows.signer: <leaf signer CN of the release signature, one of the catalog's signers.windows>

leia_conversion._registered_as: ConversionProviders\leia-conversion (Windows registry, 64-bit view); 050-leia-conversion-conversion-provider.json (Linux manifest). ProbeOrder 50, conversion provider API 1.

_external_prerequisite.name: NeurD runtime (Leia)
_external_prerequisite._note: NOT shipped, downloaded or installed by this component or by DisplayXR. Schema 1 cannot express an external requirement; a client should detect it and report met / unmet, never install it.
_external_prerequisite._min_version_note: 0.4.6 is the provider's default floor (the MinVersion setting). Linux look-around (views that follow the viewer) needs a NeurD that exports NeurD_get_table_size, first released as 0.5.0; an older one still converts, with a fixed pair.

detect.windows: PATH, then NEURD_PATH, then HKLM\SOFTWARE\LeiaInc\NeurD (default value = its directory, `Version`); or only where the NeurDPath setting says
detect.linux: /opt/immersity/neurd-runtime (libNeurD.so, VERSION.txt), then NEURD_PATH, LD_LIBRARY_PATH, ${XDG_DATA_HOME:-~/.local/share}/LeiaInc/NeurD-Runtime; or only where the NeurDPath setting says
detect.authoritative: `displayxr-cli conv status` on the box: ABSENT = not found, FAILED(VERSION) = older than the floor

_external_prerequisite.licence: handled by the vendor, inside NeurD. This component's own code is Apache-2.0.
_external_prerequisite.network: needed at NeurD's first activation (its licence check); the provider reports FAILED(NETWORK), retried, until it succeeds, and UNLICENSED when it is refused
